case.description: Sanitized regression fixture derived from public Demo behavior. Identifiers, times and durations are illustrative; scripted actions check harness behavior, not model quality.

incident.title: Product browsing and checkout intermittently stall
incident.description: Customers report intermittent long waits while browsing products and placing orders. Some requests still succeed. Investigate the shared source of latency using current telemetry.

evidence.summary: Holding an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE table lock on catalog.products; catalog reads may wait.

args.root_cause: product-catalog logs explicitly identify lock contention holding ACCESS EXCLUSIVE on catalog.products; verify affected queries and the blocking transaction before remediation.
